patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-resolution editorial photography and video are used as dominant section backgrounds, often with centered text overlays.
A strong typographic hierarchy is established with elegant, large serif headings contrasted with clean, smaller sans-serif body text and uppercase labels.
A sophisticated monochrome palette of black, white, and various greys dominates, allowing product imagery to introduce vibrant accent colors naturally.
The primary hero section features a subtle parallax effect where the background image scrolls slower than the foreground content. The main navigation remains sticky at the top.
Specific interior pages or product showcases (e.g., 'Coco Game') feature complex 3D interactive models that animate and reveal descriptive text based on scroll depth.
Content is organized into distinct, full-width blocks, each typically featuring a single large image or video with a concise title and call-to-action.

technique_notes: A fixed header navigation bar remains visible at the top of the viewport across all pages.
The initial hero section uses a background image that scrolls at a slightly slower rate than the foreground content, creating a subtle parallax effect.
Subsequent content sections on the homepage are revealed as the user scrolls, appearing from the bottom of the viewport without explicit fade or slide animations.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) are paired with smaller, clean sans-serif body text and uppercase labels, creating a sophisticated and clear hierarchy.
design_tokens.spacing: airy — large full-bleed imagery and generous vertical spacing between sections create a sense of luxury and openness.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its seamless integration of high-fashion editorial photography and video as the primary content, creating an immersive, magazine-like experience. The sophisticated typography and the use of advanced 3D interactive elements for specific product showcases elevate it beyond a typical e-commerce site, making it feel more like a digital art gallery or luxury publication.
